_about: Corner aliases for enrich_corner_assignments. Keys under 'layouts' are iRacing track ids. Each alias is matched as a whole phrase, case-insensitive, and only counts when it appears in the transcript text around the note. An alias listed for more than one corner of a layout is ignored there (ambiguous). Named corners in the knowledge packs are added automatically (with 'bocht', 'corner', 'bend', 'curve' removed and Dutch ij/y spellings), so list only what speakers say that the packs do not. 'global' aliases apply to every layout; 'first' and 'last' mean the layout's first and last turn.

485._name: Circuit Zandvoort - Grand Prix. 'banking' is deliberately not an alias: speakers use it for both Hugenholtz (T3) and Arie Luyendyk (T14).
